topic: Whether to store persona reasoning verbatim or only structured summaries

positions.position: Store structured fields only; avoid verbatim reasoning.
arguments: Reduces privacy risk and token bloat
Easier to diff and query contributions

positions.position: Keep verbatim reasoning with redaction; summaries alone lose nuance.
arguments: We can redact and expire raw text

resolution_description: Store structured fields plus short redacted rationale excerpt (<=200 chars) with TTL on raw reasoning.

topic: Should contributions reference only the immediate prior contribution or allow arbitrary links

positions.position: Allow arbitrary links; build a DAG for context.
arguments: UI can still show a linear 'primary' thread

positions.position: Immediate prior only; keep the model simple.
arguments: Most users think in a sequence

topic: Default conflict policy when two personas assert mutually exclusive facts

positions.position: Auto-flag as disagreement and require resolution step.
Allow both to stand with confidence labels; don't block progress.
arguments: Some conflicts are unresolved in real life

resolution_description: Keep both claims with evidence links and confidence; create an auto-generated disagreement requiring a later resolution or table.

topic: Whether to enforce persona identity via signed keys or allow ad-hoc personas

positions.position: Signed keys required for persona actions.
Allow ad-hoc personas for experiments; gate only production.
arguments: We can label unverified personas clearly

resolution_description: Support unverified personas in sandbox sessions; production sessions require signed persona keys with rotation.

topic: How to represent disagreements: separate entity vs embedded in session output JSON

positions.position: Separate collection for disagreements with stable IDs.
Embed inside session document for simplicity.

resolution_description: Keep disagreements as first-class records; session output stores only references for quick rendering.

topic: Whether to allow persona-specific visibility (private notes) within a session

positions.position: No private notes; everything shared to maintain collaboration.
Allow private notes for moderation and coaching.
arguments: Can be excluded from final outputs

resolution_description: Deferred until governance policy is drafted; add feature flag stub only.

topic: Schema for positions.arguments: free text array vs structured {claim,evidenceUrl}

positions.position: Structured claims with evidence URLs.
Free text arguments; structure later with extraction.

resolution_description: Accept free text now but reserve fields for claim/evidence; run nightly extraction to populate structured slots when possible.

topic: Whether to auto-close disagreements once a final recommendation is produced

positions.position: Auto-close to reduce clutter.
arguments: Most users don't revisit old threads

positions.position: Keep open unless explicitly resolved; recommendations can be wrong.
arguments: Some sessions end under time pressure

resolution_description: Auto-suggest closure when recommendation is finalized, but require explicit moderator action to resolve.

topic: Time limit for a disagreement before it is automatically tabled

positions.position: Auto-table after 72 hours of inactivity.
arguments: Lets escalations focus on fresh items

positions.position: No auto-table; some investigations take weeks.

topic: Whether to permit LLM-generated personas to vote in resolutions

positions.position: No voting rights for synthetic personas.
Allow if clearly labeled; they can break ties.
Allow input but not binding votes; moderator decides.

resolution_description: Synthetic personas may contribute positions but do not count as binding votes; moderator records the resolution.

topic: Should the system store intermediate 'draft' session outputs on every stage transition

positions.position: Yes, persist drafts; enable rollback.
Only store on milestones; drafts bloat storage.

resolution_description: Persist drafts at stage boundaries and on explicit 'checkpoint' action; prune drafts after 30 days.

topic: How strict should JSON schema validation be for positions payloads

positions.position: Strict validation; reject unknown fields.
Lenient validation; accept and ignore unknown fields.

resolution_description: Strict for required fields and types; allow unknown fields under positions[].meta object only.

topic: Whether to include a 'disagreement severity' score in the model

positions.position: Yes; severity helps triage.
No numeric score; people will game it.

resolution_description: Needs governance and examples; parked for now.

topic: Retention policy for resolved disagreements (90 days vs 1 year)

positions.position: 90 days default; minimize retained sensitive data.
1 year; training and audit value.

resolution_description: Default 180 days with per-tenant overrides; redact sensitive fields and keep hashes for long-term analytics.

topic: Whether to require evidence links for factual claims in positions

positions.position: Require evidence links for factual claims.
Do not require; too much friction for users.
arguments: Users often reason from internal docs
Not all claims have public URLs

resolution_description: Evidence links required when claim is marked 'factual' and externally sourced; otherwise allow 'internal' evidence tag.

topic: How to handle duplicate disagreements created by concurrent edits

positions.position: Deduplicate by topic hash + session_id.
Keep duplicates but merge later with admin tool.

resolution_description: Auto-dedupe exact matches (normalized topic); keep near-dupes but suggest merge with similarity score.

topic: Should 'tabled' disagreements appear in the final session summary

positions.position: Hide by default; final summary should be actionable.
Include; unresolved risks must be visible.

resolution_description: Include a short 'Open Questions' appendix listing tabled disagreements with one-line risk note.

topic: Whether to allow personas to retract a position after posting

positions.position: Allow retract with immutable audit entry.
No retract; only add follow-up contributions.

topic: Whether resolutions should record who decided (personaId) in addition to type/description

positions.position: Yes, store decided_by for accountability.
Not needed; session already has moderators list.

resolution_description: Model change deferred; track in activity log for now.

topic: How many positions are required to resolve a disagreement (2 vs 3+)

positions.position: Two opposing positions can be enough to resolve.
Require 3+ when impact is high.

resolution_description: Default 2 positions; require 3+ for topics tagged 'safety', 'security', or 'legal'.

topic: Whether to normalize topic strings (lowercase, trim) on write

positions.position: Normalize on write to reduce duplicates.
Preserve original casing for readability.

resolution_description: Store raw topic plus normalized_topic in downstream index; keep displayed topic as entered.

topic: Whether to allow external webhook callbacks on disagreement resolution events

positions.position: Yes; webhooks enable automation in Jira/Slack.
Not by default; webhooks are exfiltration risk.

resolution_description: Webhooks allowed per-tenant with allowlisted domains and payload redaction; default off.

topic: Whether to treat rate-limited persona writes as failures or retryable events

positions.position: Retry with exponential backoff; keep disagreement open.
Fail fast and require user retry; retries can amplify spikes.
arguments: Users can choose when to retry

resolution_description: Treat 429 as retryable with capped backoff and jitter; mark attempt in logs but do not create duplicate disagreements.

topic: Whether to allow deleting a disagreement record

positions.position: No deletes; only archive/tabled to preserve audit.
Allow delete for accidental duplicates in drafts.

resolution_description: No hard delete; allow 'tabled' with description 'archived duplicate' and hide from default views.

topic: Whether to allow cross-session linking of disagreements

positions.position: Yes; recurring topics benefit from cross-session lineage.
No; keep sessions isolated to avoid permissions leaks.

topic: Whether to require moderator approval before marking a disagreement resolved

positions.position: Yes, moderator approval required.
No; allow auto-resolve on consensus signals.

resolution_description: Auto-resolve allowed only when all human personas explicitly agree; otherwise moderator approval required.

topic: Whether to make tabled disagreements expire automatically after a quarter

positions.position: Expire after 90 days; convert to archived.
Do not expire; unresolved risks can resurface.

resolution_description: Parked pending reporting requirements; add 'review_by' reminder in UI instead of auto-expire for now.

topic: Whether to compress positions.arguments to save space

positions.position: No compression at app layer; let storage handle it.
Compress large payloads; costs add up at scale.

resolution_description: No custom compression; enforce argument length limits and rely on DB compression for JSON columns.

topic: Whether to allow a single persona to hold multiple positions in the same disagreement

positions.position: Allow multiple positions with labels (hypothesis A/B).
One position per persona; follow-ups can revise.

topic: When a disagreement is resolved, should old positions be locked from edits

positions.position: Lock positions; edits should be append-only.
Allow minor edits (typos) after resolution.

resolution_description: Lock positions after resolution; allow only whitespace/typo edits via moderated 'edit request' that records a diff entry.

topic: Whether to allow attachments (PDFs) as evidence for positions

positions.position: Yes; users often have vendor PDFs or policies.
No direct uploads; use links to approved storage.

resolution_description: Allow attachments only via pre-signed links to approved buckets; require malware scan before making visible.

topic: Whether to tag disagreements with domain labels (security, ux, cost)

positions.position: Yes; tags help reporting and routing.
Not in core model; keep minimal, add later.

resolution_description: Add optional tags field in v2; for now store labels in topic prefix like '[security]' and index it.

topic: Whether tabled disagreements should be editable

positions.position: Editable; tabled often means 'needs more info'.
arguments: Supports later re-opening via new record

positions.position: Not editable; tabled should freeze state.

resolution_description: Editable only to add new positions; existing positions are immutable once tabled.

topic: Whether to surface disagreements in search results for session discovery

positions.position: Yes; disagreements are high-signal summaries.
No; could leak sensitive content through search snippets.

resolution_description: Index only topic text and redacted keywords; never index arguments or personaIds; enforce tenant-scoped search.

topic: Should the UI show 'minority report' positions after resolution

positions.position: Yes; keep minority views visible for context.
Hide by default; confuses readers.

topic: Whether to allow 'tabled' as a resolution_type for resolved records

positions.position: No; resolved implies a non-tabled outcome.
Yes; some teams 'resolve by tabling'.

resolution_description: Keep status and resolution separate: status=tabled for deferral; resolved must be consensus/compromise/integration only.

topic: Whether to permit resolving without a description (type only)

positions.position: Allow type-only to reduce friction.
Require description; otherwise context is lost.

resolution_description: Resolution description remains required; keep it short with templates like 'Accepted A due to X'.
